paragraphs.en: It is a player's ornamentation that gives them their unique sound. It is due to ornamentation that Ingwi Malmsteen playing through a $30 amplifier still sounds like Ingwi Malmsteen.
paragraphs.ca: És l'ornamentació d'un guitarrista el que li dona el seu so únic. És gràcies a l'ornamentació que l'Ingwi Malmsteen, tocant amb un amplificador de 30 dòlars, continua sonant com l'Ingwi Malmsteen.

paragraphs.en: What affects tone? Several factors affect your tone roughly in the following order. 1. Amplifier 2. Effects 3. Pickups 4. Strings 5. Guitar body 6. The tone control on the guitar The amplifier Your amplifier will have the biggest effect on tone.
paragraphs.ca: Què afecta el so? Diversos factors afecten el teu so, més o menys en aquest ordre. 1. Amplificador 2. Efectes 3. Pastilles 4. Cordes 5. Cos de la guitarra 6. El control de to de la guitarra. L'amplificador. El teu amplificador tindrà l'efecte més gran sobre el so.

paragraphs.en: There are several types of amplifiers that are available today. Valve, solid state and modelling. How amplifiers work Before we look at what these different types of amplifiers are and how they work, we should probably talk a little about how amplifiers work in general.
paragraphs.ca: Avui dia hi ha diversos tipus d'amplificadors disponibles. De vàlvules, d'estat sòlid i de modelatge. Com funcionen els amplificadors. Abans de veure què són aquests tipus diferents d'amplificadors i com funcionen, potser hauríem de parlar una mica de com funcionen els amplificadors en general.

paragraphs.en: When you play an electric guitar, the string vibrates. The string is vibrating above a pickup. The pickup is a set of magnets that are wrapped in electrical wire.
paragraphs.ca: Quan toques una guitarra elèctrica, la corda vibra. La corda vibra damunt d'una pastilla. La pastilla és un conjunt d'imants embolicats amb fil elèctric.

paragraphs.en: There is a wrapped magnet underneath each string. When the guitar string vibrates inside this magnetic field, an electrical voltage is induced in the wire around the pickup.
paragraphs.ca: Hi ha un imant embolicat sota cada corda. Quan la corda de la guitarra vibra dins d'aquest camp magnètic, s'indueix una tensió elèctrica al fil que envolta la pastilla.

paragraphs.en: If you want to learn more about how this works, look up Faraday's Law of Induction online. This voltage then goes from the guitar through the cable into your amplifier.
paragraphs.ca: Si vols aprendre més sobre com funciona això, busca en línia la llei d'inducció de Faraday. Aquesta tensió passa llavors de la guitarra, a través del cable, cap al teu amplificador.

paragraphs.en: Your amplifier has several controls, but the basics of what it does is to use your guitar output to regulate a more powerful signal.
paragraphs.ca: El teu amplificador té diversos controls, però bàsicament el que fa és fer servir la sortida de la teva guitarra per regular un senyal més potent.

paragraphs.en: You can imagine the amplifier is a powerful river with a gate. The output from your guitar regulates how open or closed the gate in the river is, controlling how much of the powerful river can flow through the gate.
paragraphs.ca: Et pots imaginar l'amplificador com un riu cabalós amb una comporta. La sortida de la teva guitarra regula com d'oberta o tancada està la comporta del riu, controlant quanta aigua del riu cabalós pot passar per la comporta.

paragraphs.en: This variation in the flow of the powerful river matches the varying voltage coming from your guitar. It's like taking a small key and cutting a much bigger key that has the same shape.
paragraphs.ca: Aquesta variació en el cabal del riu potent es correspon amb la tensió variable que arriba de la teva guitarra. És com agafar una clau petita i tallar-ne una de molt més gran que tingui la mateixa forma.

paragraphs.en: This is how you take the weak signal from your guitar and turn it into something powerful enough to be heard from your amplifier speaker.
paragraphs.ca: Així és com agafes el senyal feble de la teva guitarra i el converteixes en una cosa prou potent perquè se senti per l'altaveu de l'amplificador.

paragraphs.en: Amplifiers are usually broken into three sections. 1. Preamp 2. Poweramp 3. Speaker Cabinet The preamp is a section that does most of the tone shaping.
paragraphs.ca: Els amplificadors solen dividir-se en tres seccions. 1. Preamplificador 2. Etapa de potència 3. Caixa d'altaveus. El preamplificador és la secció que fa la major part del modelatge del so.

paragraphs.en: You can fiddle with EQ buttons and overdrive here. The power amp is mainly what we described above. It's the bit that makes your guitar signal loud.
paragraphs.ca: Aquí pots jugar amb els botons d'equalització i amb l'overdrive. L'etapa de potència és sobretot el que hem descrit més amunt. És la part que fa que el senyal de la teva guitarra soni fort.

paragraphs.en: The speaker cabinets are the speakers. They take the powerful signal from the power amplifier and turn it from electricity into sound.
paragraphs.ca: Les caixes d'altaveus són els altaveus. Agafen el senyal potent de l'etapa de potència i el converteixen d'electricitat en so.

paragraphs.en: All three of these sections affect your tone. Combo amps are amps with all three sections built into one. Heads are a box that combines the preamp and power amp.
paragraphs.ca: Aquestes tres seccions afecten el teu so. Els amplificadors combo són amplificadors amb les tres seccions integrades en un de sol. Els head són una caixa que combina el preamplificador i l'etapa de potència.

paragraphs.en: Cabs are speaker cabinets that you can plug your head into. Speaker cabinets can have different speakers in them, which has a big impact on tone.
paragraphs.ca: Els cab són caixes d'altaveus on pots connectar el teu head. Les caixes d'altaveus poden portar altaveus diferents, cosa que té un impacte gran en el so.

paragraphs.en: They can also come in different sizes, be chambered, this is the internal construction, and be built from different thickness woods, which can affect the tone.
paragraphs.ca: També poden tenir mides diferents, estar compartimentades —això és la construcció interna— i estar fetes de fustes de gruixos diferents, cosa que pot afectar el so.

paragraphs.en: Rack units are effectively a way to build your own amp, where the preamp and power amp are separate. This gives you more control over the tone.
paragraphs.ca: Les unitats de rack són, efectivament, una manera de construir el teu propi amplificador, amb el preamplificador i l'etapa de potència separats. Això et dona més control sobre el so.

paragraphs.en: Racks are usually MIDI controlled, which is a system whereby you can press one button on a pedal board and change all your preamp and effects settings at once.
paragraphs.ca: Els racks solen estar controlats per MIDI, que és un sistema que et permet prémer un botó en una pedalera i canviar tots els ajustos del preamplificador i dels efectes alhora.

paragraphs.en: You may have seen inputs and outputs on your amplifier labelled effects loop. This gives you a way to put guitar effects between the preamp and power amp.
paragraphs.ca: Potser has vist entrades i sortides al teu amplificador etiquetades com a «bucle d'efectes». Això et dona una manera de posar efectes de guitarra entre el preamplificador i l'etapa de potència.

paragraphs.en: Solid state amplifiers Solid state refers to the method by which the signal is amplified. In a solid-state amplifier, transistors are used to control the amplification.
paragraphs.ca: Amplificadors d'estat sòlid. Estat sòlid fa referència al mètode amb què s'amplifica el senyal. En un amplificador d'estat sòlid, es fan servir transistors per controlar l'amplificació.

paragraphs.en: There are different types of transistors which can affect the quality of the signal. The big benefit to using transistors is that they are cheap and reliable.
paragraphs.ca: Hi ha tipus diferents de transistors que poden afectar la qualitat del senyal. El gran avantatge de fer servir transistors és que són barats i fiables.

paragraphs.en: They last forever.
paragraphs.ca: Duren per sempre.

paragraphs.en: Valve amplifiers. These, unsurprisingly, use valves to amplify the signal. Valves are also known as vacuum tubes. Vacuum tubes were used in the first electronic computers before moving into commercial technology.
paragraphs.ca: Amplificadors de vàlvules. Aquests, com era d'esperar, fan servir vàlvules per amplificar el senyal. Les vàlvules també es coneixen com a tubs de buit. Els tubs de buit es van fer servir en els primers ordinadors electrònics abans de passar a la tecnologia comercial.

paragraphs.en: They were used in everything from old TV sets to AM, FM radio. These days, most valve electronics are obsolete. They're only being used in high-end hi-fis and guitar amplifiers.
paragraphs.ca: Es feien servir en tot, des de televisors antics fins a ràdios AM i FM. Avui dia, la majoria d'electrònica de vàlvules és obsoleta. Només es fa servir en equips d'alta fidelitat d'alt nivell i en amplificadors de guitarra.

paragraphs.en: Due to how valves work, when they are pushed hard, the signal that is being amplified starts to break down in a way that is deemed favorable, which is the source of valve overdrive. Valve amplifiers tend to sound best when they are pushed hard to create more of this signal breakdown, hence the term overdrive from the valves being driven hard.
paragraphs.ca: A causa de com funcionen les vàlvules, quan se les força molt, el senyal que s'amplifica comença a degradar-se d'una manera que es considera favorable, i aquesta és la font de l'overdrive de les vàlvules. Els amplificadors de vàlvules solen sonar millor quan se'ls força molt per crear més d'aquesta degradació del senyal; d'aquí ve el terme overdrive, pel fet de portar les vàlvules al límit.

paragraphs.en: Generally speaking, valve amplifiers are accepted as having the best guitar tone. The benefit of valve amplifiers is the sound. The downside is that they are more expensive, heavier and require expensive maintenance. The valves will fail over time and need to be replaced.
paragraphs.ca: En termes generals, s'accepta que els amplificadors de vàlvules tenen el millor so de guitarra. L'avantatge dels amplificadors de vàlvules és el so. L'inconvenient és que són més cars, més pesants i requereixen un manteniment car. Les vàlvules fallaran amb el temps i s'hauran de substituir.

paragraphs.en: Modeling amplifiers. Modeling amplifiers seek to take the distortions that a valve introduces into the guitar signal and model how that distortion behaves.
paragraphs.ca: Amplificadors de modelatge. Els amplificadors de modelatge busquen agafar les distorsions que introdueix una vàlvula en el senyal de la guitarra i modelar com es comporta aquesta distorsió.

paragraphs.en: The model is put into an algorithm and applied to your guitar signal. This is what units such as the Kemper and Fractalax FX do.
paragraphs.ca: El model s'introdueix en un algorisme i s'aplica al senyal de la teva guitarra. Això és el que fan unitats com el Kemper i el Fractalax FX.

paragraphs.en: The benefits of modeling units are that they are much more portable than a valve amplifier. They are also more reliable.
paragraphs.ca: Els avantatges de les unitats de modelatge són que són molt més portables que un amplificador de vàlvules. També són més fiables.

paragraphs.en: Usually, they are plugged straight into a PA system or a speaker cabinet. Cost-wise, they are usually about the same price or more than a full valve setup, head and cab.
paragraphs.ca: Normalment es connecten directament a un sistema de PA o a una caixa d'altaveus. Pel que fa al cost, solen tenir més o menys el mateix preu, o més, que un equip complet de vàlvules, amb head i cab.

paragraphs.en: The sound quality is very close, but usually not quite the same as a valve amplifier.
paragraphs.ca: La qualitat del so és molt propera, però normalment no del tot igual que la d'un amplificador de vàlvules.

paragraphs.en: Effects The next biggest impact on your tone will be from your effects. There are many types of effects that you can use and they will impact your tone.
paragraphs.ca: Els efectes. El segon impacte més gran en el teu so vindrà dels teus efectes. Hi ha molts tipus d'efectes que pots fer servir i que afectaran el teu so.

paragraphs.en: There are two ways the effects can impact your tone. One, the way they change your sound, the effect they are adding. Two, the quality of the DAC in the pedal, if it has it.
paragraphs.ca: Hi ha dues maneres com els efectes poden afectar el teu so. Una, la manera com canvien el teu so, l'efecte que afegeixen. Dues, la qualitat del DAC del pedal, si en té.

paragraphs.en: DAC stands for Digital to Analog Converter. This is sometimes known as ADA, Analog to Digital to Analog. The signal coming out of your guitar is analog.
paragraphs.ca: DAC vol dir convertidor digital-analògic. De vegades també es coneix com a ADA, analògic-digital-analògic. El senyal que surt de la teva guitarra és analògic.

paragraphs.en: It's a continuously varying voltage. Some guitar pedals will use a tiny computer, a couple of microchips, inside the pedal to add the effect.
paragraphs.ca: És una tensió que varia contínuament. Alguns pedals de guitarra fan servir un petit ordinador, un parell de microxips, dins del pedal per afegir l'efecte.

paragraphs.en: This computer requires the signal from the guitar, analog, to be chopped up and quantized via a DAC, after which it will process the signal, add the effect, and then take the digital signal and put it back into analog.
paragraphs.ca: Aquest ordinador necessita que el senyal de la guitarra, que és analògic, es divideixi en trossos i es quantifiqui mitjançant un DAC; després processarà el senyal, afegirà l'efecte i llavors agafarà el senyal digital i el tornarà a posar en analògic.

paragraphs.en: If the DAC is cheap, it can hurt the tone. Most higher-end pedals will be fine for this. Bear in mind that all music you listen to has been through multiple rounds of ADA conversion.
paragraphs.ca: Si el DAC és barat, pot perjudicar el so. La majoria de pedals d'alta gamma estan bé en aquest aspecte. Tingues en compte que tota la música que escoltes ha passat per múltiples rondes de conversió ADA.

paragraphs.en: The negative influence that effects can have on your tone is known as tone suck. A good way around this is to have a completely dry signal, Dry means no effects, wet means effects have been added, with the effects added on top of the dry signal.
paragraphs.ca: La influència negativa que els efectes poden tenir sobre el teu so es coneix com a tone suck. Una bona manera d'evitar-ho és tenir un senyal completament sec —sec vol dir sense efectes, i humit vol dir que s'hi han afegit efectes—, amb els efectes afegits a sobre del senyal sec.

paragraphs.en: This can be done in stereo and is known as a WDW setup, wet-dry-wet. Big rack systems sometimes use WDW to create a huge guitar sound.
paragraphs.ca: Això es pot fer en estèreo i es coneix com a configuració WDW, humit-sec-humit. Els sistemes de rack grans de vegades fan servir WDW per crear un so de guitarra enorme.

paragraphs.en: Pickups The next biggest factor in your tone is the pickups in your guitar. If your guitar has come with stock, that is manufacturer-supplied pickups, you will find a big difference by changing them to top-tier pickups.
paragraphs.ca: Les pastilles. El factor següent més important del teu so són les pastilles de la teva guitarra. Si la teva guitarra ve amb pastilles de sèrie, és a dir, les que proporciona el fabricant, notaràs una gran diferència si les canvies per pastilles d'alta gamma.

paragraphs.en: As a note, higher-end guitars tend to come with good pickups. There are two types of pickups. One, active. Two, passive.
paragraphs.ca: Com a nota, les guitarres d'alta gamma solen venir amb bones pastilles. Hi ha dos tipus de pastilles. Una, activa. Dues, passiva.

paragraphs.en: Passive pickups are magnets wrapped in wire, and that's it. Active pickups use fewer turns of higher gauge wire than passive pickups.
paragraphs.ca: Les pastilles passives són imants embolicats amb fil, i prou. Les pastilles actives fan servir menys voltes de fil de calibre més gruixut que les pastilles passives.

paragraphs.en: This results in lower output than passive pickups, so they have a small pre-amp built into them, which requires a battery to run and in turn leads to a higher output than passive pickups.
paragraphs.ca: Això dona una sortida més baixa que les pastilles passives, així que tenen un petit preamplificador integrat que necessita una pila per funcionar, cosa que al seu torn dona una sortida més alta que les pastilles passives.

paragraphs.en: Footnote 7. Active pickups are often popular amongst extreme metal players. Passive pickups tend to have a more organic feel.
paragraphs.ca: Nota 7. Les pastilles actives sovint són populars entre els guitarristes de metall extrem. Les pastilles passives solen tenir una sensació més orgànica.

paragraphs.en: An additional consideration with your pickups is how close they are to the strings. When the pickups are raised, they will give a higher output, but the magnetic field of the pickup will fight against the vibration of the strings, reducing the length of time that the strings will ring out, known as the sustain.
paragraphs.ca: Una consideració addicional amb les teves pastilles és com de prop estan de les cordes. Quan les pastilles estan més altes, donen més sortida, però el camp magnètic de la pastilla lluitarà contra la vibració de les cordes, cosa que redueix el temps que les cordes ressonen, conegut com a sustain.

paragraphs.en: When the pickups are lowered, they are further from the strings, reducing the output but increasing the sustain. Balancing output and sustain takes a bit of trial and error.
paragraphs.ca: Quan les pastilles estan més baixes, són més lluny de les cordes, cosa que redueix la sortida però augmenta el sustain. Equilibrar la sortida i el sustain requereix una mica de prova i error.

paragraphs.en: This is something that a luthier or tech may do for you when setting up your guitar.
paragraphs.ca: Això és una cosa que un luthier o un tècnic et pot fer quan et posa a punt la guitarra.

paragraphs.en: Strings
paragraphs.ca: Cordes

segments.text: Strings
Your strings will have an impact on your tone and playability.
New strings have a clear tone and are usually a bit easier to play.
Old strings can muddy your tone slightly but a bit harder to play and also stick to your fingers a little.
There are several different companies making strings, some of which use different metals for the strings.
You can find review videos online, something YouTube is great for.
Strings also have different gauges, which is the thickness of the string.
Again, there are some good YouTube videos comparing string gauges.
How often should you change your strings?
String manufacturers, for some reason, tend to recommend that you change your strings every 10 seconds.
I usually follow these rules.
Change your strings for gigs recording sessions.
When practicing, change them every month or so
Maybe less if you're trying to save a few quid
In general, when your higher strings start to discolor, they are starting to lose tone
When dirt is collecting on the back of the string, they are due for a change
Guitar body
The final factor in your tone is the guitar itself
The woods it is made out of and the way the neck is attached to the body
There are two possible ways to attach the neck to an electric guitar.
1. Neck through.
2. Bolt on.
Bolt on is where the neck is bolted onto the guitar.
The neck will sit in a socket on the guitar with a few large bolts in the back to hold it on.
Neck through construction is where the neck is an integral part of the guitar body.
The neck will run through the length of the guitar body with extra parts attached to the side to fill out the body.
Footnote 8
These effects on tone are minimal compared to other factors, but can make a difference.
Guitar Tone Control
This is a dial, usually the lower dial, on your guitar.
It has a small capacitor, and it is used to remove some of the high end from your output signal.
Some guitar players like to remove this from their guitars.
Tone Blocks
At the body end of your guitar, the strings attach to the bridge.
Increasing the mass of the bridge will cause the strings to vibrate for a longer time
and can affect the frequencies in the string.
That is, frequencies that would normally be lost have a chance to exist for longer.
This can be accomplished by what is called a tone block,
which is a large block of metal screwed into the back of your bridge.
They can make a big difference.
I was pleasantly surprised by how my guitar sounded after having one fitted.
Cables.
Cables do not affect your tone. There is a lot of pseudoscience and voodoo around cables.
The best thing for a cable is to get something that is tough so that it doesn't break easily,
and is well shielded to prevent it from acting like an antenna and picking up other electromagnetic signals.
Guitar tone for practice
When practicing and developing your technique, you don't want to have too much reverb or delay etc. on your sound.
This is because they can make it difficult to hear your timing too accurately.
By all means, use a little, but use it very sparingly.
When working on technique, I like to use a clean, dry tone.
Improving your tone.
To wrap up, if you want to improve your tone, work through the above list in the above order.
Change the biggest factors first, for example, your amplifier, then work through the rest of the list in order.
Your guitar.
Higher-end guitars are usually nicer to play and are built with better quality components.
I have always loved Ibanez guitars, and that's all I play.
You can usually get a quite good deal on second-hand Ibanez's, saving up to 50% on the new price.
When you buy a guitar, it's usually worth taking it to a luthier guitar technician to get the guitar set up.
This involves changing the strings, something you can do easily yourself,
but also setting the intonation and neck balance. Setting intonation and neck balance is something
you can do yourself, but you have to know what you are doing. It's a complex job and easy to
make mistakes. The setup can also include pickup height adjustment and pole height adjustment.
Having your guitar set up properly makes a big difference to how playable it is,
often feeling like a different instrument. A good luthier will also be able to make
little adjustments to the guitar to make it more playable and fix any slight manufacturing defects,
which cheaper instruments tend to have. For example, the neck socket on my Ibanez was ever
so slightly larger than the neck. My luthier inserted a piece of rubber into the joint to
create a perfect fit. If you are doing some serious recording or getting ready to play some gigs,
getting your guitar set up will help give you an edge. For those that are interested,
I've had the pickups replaced, had the frets dressed three times, eventually replacing the
frets with stainless steel frets, replaced a broken volume control, and fitted a tone block
to the back of the bridge. Fret dressing. As you play the guitar, the metal strings are pressed
against the frets. Over time, the frets will become worn down and flattened. This creates
poor contact when the string is pressed against it, which can create buzz. Fret dressing is when
the fret is filed and reshaped to create perfect contact with the string. How many times your
frets can undergo this process is dependent on the size of the fret. A bigger fret can be filed
more times than a smaller fret. Finding a good luthier technician. A luthier is someone who can
build a guitar. A guitar technician, often shortened to tech or guitar tech, adjusts guitars
but does not build them. There is often some overlap between what they can do.
Finding a reliable and knowledgeable luthier guitar tech can be a tricky thing to do,
and like many things, often takes a bit of trial and error.
The best way is via the personal recommendation of someone you know. If you take lessons,
your teacher will probably know a reliable luthier that you can use.
I had to work my way through three guitar techs
before finally finding someone who was competent at their job.
Home Studio
If you're creating your own songs,
chances are you will be using some version of a home studio,
whether it's simple or complex.
We'll look at the basics of a home studio
and a few upgrades you can consider getting,
and then we'll talk about all the components.
There are roughly four levels of home studio.
1. Your basic setup will be a computer, headphones and interface, and a DAW.
2. Computer, interface, DAW and studio monitors.
3. Computer, interface, DAW, studio monitors, amplifier with power soak and impulse response modeling, software or hardware.
4. Computer, interface, DAW, studio monitors, amplifier, live room or isolation box with
microphones for the amplifier speaker cabinet. 5. Purpose-built studio. Level 1 is someone with
their laptop. Level 5 is a purpose-built studio. Home studio components. Computer. This is the
of your studio. You'll need a computer with 1. USB ports for a sound interface and external storage.
2. At least 8GB of RAM, ideally 16GB or even 32GB. 3. Intel i53GHz quad-core processor,
Apple M1 processor or better. 4. Enough storage for your compositions. A recorded song in a DAW
can run to 300 megabytes to 700 megabytes depending on how many tracks you are using.
A fully produced song can be up to 5 gigabytes. 250 gigabytes internal drive with an external drive
is a good starting point. If the internal and external drives are solid state, even better.
I use a late 2015, it's 2022 when I'm writing this book, so this computer is currently 7 years old,
iMac with a 3.2 GHz quad-core Intel i5 with 8 GB of RAM. My computer is fast enough for doing
recording, one track at a time, working with a virtual orchestra and recording rock music with
sample libraries. It slows down a little and playback starts and stops with bigger projects,
so I'll upgrade the RAM to 16 GB or 32 GB sometime soon, but for 90% of what I do with it,
it's fine. The point is, you need a computer that is good enough, but it doesn't have to be a
supercomputer. But do make sure you check the specifications for any software, plugins,
libraries, equipment you intend to use. Sound interface. This is a box that you can plug into
your computer and then plug instruments, microphones, headphones, studio monitors,
and other musical equipment into. At a basic level, you can get a USB dongle with an input
for your guitar and an output for your headphones. These can go for around £20.
Beringer makes something like this that I started with. The next level up is something that can
handle studio monitors, headphones, two guitars or microphones, with gain controls and line
instrument inputs. The Focusrite Scarlett. 2i4 is an excellent option at this level.
I've used mine for years now and many students love them. These are great for recording vocals,
guitar or other instruments where you need a maximum of two microphones. These cost around
£130 to £200. They can handle line, instrument or XLR inputs with a variety of outputs.
The difference in price for similar interfaces is usually down to features and the quality of the audio-to-digital conversion, known as DAC for Digital Analog Converter.
Higher quality DACs are usually more expensive.
You only start to need more complex interfaces if you want to record multiple instruments or microphones at once.
For example, if you're recording drums, you can need a minimum of 10 microphones.
Usually, at this level, Rack is a little bit more than a
Interfaces with plenty of inputs are used. You will also need a powerful computer to track that many microphones at once.

Headphones. You need some way to listen to what you have recorded. Good speakers are expensive, so if you are on a limited budget, I would recommend a semi-decent pair of studio headphones. Your headphones should be wired.
Wireless, or Bluetooth, headphones can have a small amount of latency.
When you are just listening to music for fun, this isn't a problem,
but when you are recording, this latency will be noticeable and incredibly annoying.
When using the headphones, plug them directly into your sound interface.
Have them set loud enough, but don't go blasting your ears with them.
Also be aware that with prolonged use, your ears get used to loudness,
So for a given loudness, it can be perceived as getting quieter as time goes on,
leading to increasing the volume over and over, which is a recipe for long-term hearing damage.
When using headphones, take them off every 20 minutes or so to give your ears a little rest
and reset your perception of volume.
Monitors
Monitors is a fancy name for good quality speakers.
Normal PC speakers aren't good enough.
They have a limited frequency response.
Ideally, you want something that is powered, with separate bass and treble cones.
You'll need speaker cables to connect the monitors to your sound interface.
Usually, these are not included with the monitors.
I found the M-Audio BX8 to be pretty good for this.
Set up your monitors so they form two points of an equilateral triangle,
with you forming the third point.
They should be pointing directly at you.
Good monitors can cost £300 for a pair.
Power Soak, Loadbox.
This is a device you can plug your power amp into that will make the signal smaller.
Valve amplifiers sound best when they are turned up loud,
but if you are recording at home, this may not be practical
and you may well get complaints from your neighbour's housemates,
not to mention damaging your hearing unless you can put your amp in an isolated room.
Additionally, you cannot plug the output of your amplifier into your sound interface,
as the signal will be too strong and will damage the sound interface.
A power soak is a device that is placed between the amplifier and speaker cabinet,
which makes the signal quieter without, in theory, losing any of the tone.
Popular models include THD hotplate, Marshall power brake, and two-notes torpedo range.
Many load boxes come with a line-out which allows you to plug the output of the load box into your sound interface.
There are good YouTube videos demonstrating the difference between different load boxes.
Impulse response.
Everything in your signal chain affects your tone, including, as we mentioned earlier, your speaker cabinet.
Impulse response software hardware will model the effect of a speaker cabinet on your tone.
This usually comes as software, but there are also hardware variants.
A company called Two Notes has software and hardware solutions that you can look into.
Many modern DAWs come with plugins that will load impulse responses,
and Two Notes offer a free plugin you can use with your DAW.
Isolation Box
This is a large wooden and padded box that you can place your speaker cabinet in, along with a microphone.
It is acoustically insulated so that sound can't escape, meaning you can turn up your amp nice and loud without it disturbing anyone or blasting your eardrums.
These are a good solution to recording at home, and if you don't want to buy one, you can build one.
These can sound a little dead compared to a nice studio room, but they are a great solution to recording your nice amp at home.
Microphones
If you are recording your guitar, mic'd up, you will need a microphone.
When it comes to recording guitar cabinets, the industry standard is the Shure SM57.
Set the microphone up using a mic stand, pointing directly at one of your speaker cones,
as close as you can get to the speaker cone.
The exact position of the microphone will affect the tone that you capture.
My album, Impetuous Desire, was recorded using a single SM57.
Some people like to use an additional microphone elsewhere in the room to capture the ambience.
When using multiple microphones, you have to be careful that they are in phase.
Going into the complexities of phase is outside the scope of this book,
but a quick Google will tell you all about it.
Live room
If you want to go all out, you can go and build a live room.
This is a sectioned-off room that has thick walls for sound isolation.
It may or may not have a window.
This will let you record amplifiers and other instruments easily and to a very high quality.
Some people build these in their basement or build a studio in their garden that has a live and control room.
When you go this far, you can create studio-quality recordings at home,
while the best option, this is also the most expensive and most fun.
Section 5. Your Environment

paragraphs.en: Strings Your strings will have an impact on your tone and playability. New strings have a clear tone and are usually a bit easier to play.
paragraphs.ca: Les cordes. Les teves cordes tindran un impacte en el teu so i en la facilitat de tocar. Les cordes noves tenen un so clar i normalment són una mica més fàcils de tocar.

paragraphs.en: Old strings can muddy your tone slightly but a bit harder to play and also stick to your fingers a little. There are several different companies making strings, some of which use different metals for the strings.
paragraphs.ca: Les cordes velles poden enterbolir una mica el teu so, però també són una mica més difícils de tocar i s'enganxen una mica als dits. Hi ha diverses empreses que fabriquen cordes, algunes de les quals utilitzen metalls diferents per a les cordes.

paragraphs.en: You can find review videos online, something YouTube is great for. Strings also have different gauges, which is the thickness of the string.
paragraphs.ca: Pots trobar vídeos de ressenyes en línia, cosa per a la qual YouTube és fantàstic. Les cordes també tenen gruixos diferents, que és el gruix de la corda.

paragraphs.en: Again, there are some good YouTube videos comparing string gauges. How often should you change your strings? String manufacturers, for some reason, tend to recommend that you change your strings every 10 seconds.
paragraphs.ca: De nou, hi ha alguns bons vídeos de YouTube que comparen gruixos de cordes. Amb quina freqüència has de canviar les cordes? Els fabricants de cordes, per alguna raó, tendeixen a recomanar que canviïs les cordes cada 10 segons.

paragraphs.en: I usually follow these rules. Change your strings for gigs recording sessions. When practicing, change them every month or so Maybe less if you're trying to save a few quid In general, when your higher strings start to discolor, they are starting to lose tone When dirt is collecting on the back of the string, they are due for a change Guitar body The final factor in your tone is the guitar itself The woods it is made out of and the way the neck is attached to the body
paragraphs.ca: Normalment segueixo aquestes regles. Canvia les cordes per als bolos i les sessions d'enregistrament. Quan practiquis, canvia-les cada mes més o menys. Potser menys, si intentes estalviar quatre calers. En general, quan les cordes més agudes comencen a descolorir-se, comencen a perdre el so. Quan s'acumula brutícia a la part posterior de la corda, toca canviar-les. El cos de la guitarra. L'últim factor del teu so és la guitarra mateixa: les fustes de què està feta i la manera com el mànec està unit al cos

paragraphs.en: There are two possible ways to attach the neck to an electric guitar. 1. Neck through. 2. Bolt on. Bolt on is where the neck is bolted onto the guitar.
paragraphs.ca: Hi ha dues maneres possibles d'unir el mànec a una guitarra elèctrica. 1. Neck through. 2. Bolt on. Bolt on és quan el mànec va cargolat a la guitarra.

paragraphs.en: The neck will sit in a socket on the guitar with a few large bolts in the back to hold it on. Neck through construction is where the neck is an integral part of the guitar body.
paragraphs.ca: El mànec se situa en un encaix de la guitarra, amb uns quants cargols grossos a la part posterior que el subjecten. La construcció neck through és quan el mànec és una part integral del cos de la guitarra.

paragraphs.en: The neck will run through the length of the guitar body with extra parts attached to the side to fill out the body. Footnote 8 These effects on tone are minimal compared to other factors, but can make a difference.
paragraphs.ca: El mànec travessa tota la longitud del cos de la guitarra, amb peces addicionals enganxades als costats per completar el cos. Nota 8. Aquests efectes sobre el so són mínims comparats amb altres factors, però poden marcar una diferència.

paragraphs.en: Guitar Tone Control This is a dial, usually the lower dial, on your guitar. It has a small capacitor, and it is used to remove some of the high end from your output signal.
paragraphs.ca: Control de to de la guitarra. Aquest és un potenciòmetre, normalment el de més avall, de la teva guitarra. Té un petit condensador i serveix per treure una part dels aguts del teu senyal de sortida.

paragraphs.en: Some guitar players like to remove this from their guitars. Tone Blocks At the body end of your guitar, the strings attach to the bridge.
paragraphs.ca: A alguns guitarristes els agrada treure'l de les seves guitarres. Blocs de to. A l'extrem del cos de la teva guitarra, les cordes s'uneixen al pont.

paragraphs.en: Increasing the mass of the bridge will cause the strings to vibrate for a longer time and can affect the frequencies in the string.
paragraphs.ca: Augmentar la massa del pont farà que les cordes vibrin durant més temps i pot afectar les freqüències de la corda.

paragraphs.en: That is, frequencies that would normally be lost have a chance to exist for longer. This can be accomplished by what is called a tone block, which is a large block of metal screwed into the back of your bridge.
paragraphs.ca: És a dir, les freqüències que normalment es perdrien tenen l'oportunitat d'existir durant més temps. Això es pot aconseguir amb el que s'anomena un bloc de to, que és un bloc gran de metall cargolat a la part posterior del teu pont.

paragraphs.en: They can make a big difference. I was pleasantly surprised by how my guitar sounded after having one fitted.
paragraphs.ca: Poden marcar una gran diferència. Em vaig sorprendre gratament de com sonava la meva guitarra després d'instal·lar-n'hi un.

paragraphs.en: Cables. Cables do not affect your tone. There is a lot of pseudoscience and voodoo around cables. The best thing for a cable is to get something that is tough so that it doesn't break easily, and is well shielded to prevent it from acting like an antenna and picking up other electromagnetic signals.
paragraphs.ca: Cables. Els cables no afecten el teu so. Hi ha molta pseudociència i molt de vudú al voltant dels cables. El millor per a un cable és aconseguir un que sigui resistent, perquè no es trenqui fàcilment, i ben apantallat per evitar que faci d'antena i capti altres senyals electromagnètics.

paragraphs.en: Guitar tone for practice When practicing and developing your technique, you don't want to have too much reverb or delay etc. on your sound.
paragraphs.ca: El so de la guitarra per practicar. Quan practiques i desenvolupes la teva tècnica, no vols tenir massa reverb ni delay, etc., al teu so.

paragraphs.en: This is because they can make it difficult to hear your timing too accurately. By all means, use a little, but use it very sparingly.
paragraphs.ca: Això és perquè poden dificultar sentir el teu tempo amb prou precisió. Per descomptat, fes servir una mica, però amb molta moderació.

paragraphs.en: When working on technique, I like to use a clean, dry tone.
paragraphs.ca: Quan treballo la tècnica, m'agrada fer servir un so net i sec.

paragraphs.en: Improving your tone. To wrap up, if you want to improve your tone, work through the above list in the above order. Change the biggest factors first, for example, your amplifier, then work through the rest of the list in order.
paragraphs.ca: Millorar el teu so. Per acabar, si vols millorar el teu so, treballa la llista anterior en l'ordre indicat. Canvia primer els factors més importants, per exemple el teu amplificador, i després ves treballant la resta de la llista en ordre.

paragraphs.en: Your guitar. Higher-end guitars are usually nicer to play and are built with better quality components. I have always loved Ibanez guitars, and that's all I play.
paragraphs.ca: La teva guitarra. Les guitarres de gamma alta solen ser més agradables de tocar i estan fetes amb components de més qualitat. Sempre m'han encantat les guitarres Ibanez, i només toco amb aquesta marca.

paragraphs.en: You can usually get a quite good deal on second-hand Ibanez's, saving up to 50% on the new price. When you buy a guitar, it's usually worth taking it to a luthier guitar technician to get the guitar set up.
paragraphs.ca: Normalment pots aconseguir una molt bona oferta amb una Ibanez de segona mà, estalviant fins a un 50% del preu nou. Quan compris una guitarra, normalment val la pena portar-la a un lutier o tècnic de guitarres perquè l'ajusti.

paragraphs.en: This involves changing the strings, something you can do easily yourself, but also setting the intonation and neck balance. Setting intonation and neck balance is something you can do yourself, but you have to know what you are doing. It's a complex job and easy to make mistakes. The setup can also include pickup height adjustment and pole height adjustment.
paragraphs.ca: Això implica canviar les cordes, cosa que pots fer fàcilment tu mateix, però també ajustar l'entonació i l'equilibri del mànec. Ajustar l'entonació i l'equilibri del mànec és una cosa que pots fer tu mateix, però has de saber què fas. És una feina complexa i és fàcil cometre errors. L'ajust també pot incloure l'ajust de l'alçada de les pastilles i de l'alçada dels pols.

paragraphs.en: Having your guitar set up properly makes a big difference to how playable it is, often feeling like a different instrument. A good luthier will also be able to make little adjustments to the guitar to make it more playable and fix any slight manufacturing defects, which cheaper instruments tend to have. For example, the neck socket on my Ibanez was ever so slightly larger than the neck. My luthier inserted a piece of rubber into the joint to
paragraphs.ca: Fer ajustar correctament la teva guitarra marca una gran diferència en com de tocable és, sovint sembla un instrument diferent. Un bon lutier també podrà fer petits ajustos a la guitarra per fer-la més tocable i arreglar qualsevol petit defecte de fabricació, que solen tenir els instruments més barats. Per exemple, l'encaix del mànec de la meva Ibanez era una mica més gran que el mànec. El meu lutier va inserir un tros de goma a la unió per

paragraphs.en: create a perfect fit. If you are doing some serious recording or getting ready to play some gigs, getting your guitar set up will help give you an edge. For those that are interested, I've had the pickups replaced, had the frets dressed three times, eventually replacing the frets with stainless steel frets, replaced a broken volume control, and fitted a tone block to the back of the bridge. Fret dressing. As you play the guitar, the metal strings are pressed
paragraphs.ca: aconseguir un encaix perfecte. Si estàs fent un enregistrament seriós o preparant-te per fer alguns bolos, ajustar la guitarra t'ajudarà a tenir un avantatge. Per als qui tinguin interès: he canviat les pastilles, he fet repassar els trastes tres vegades, i finalment els vaig substituir per trastes d'acer inoxidable, he canviat un control de volum espatllat i he instal·lat un bloc de to a la part posterior del pont. Repassat de trastes. A mesura que toques la guitarra, les cordes metàl·liques es premen

paragraphs.en: against the frets. Over time, the frets will become worn down and flattened. This creates poor contact when the string is pressed against it, which can create buzz. Fret dressing is when the fret is filed and reshaped to create perfect contact with the string. How many times your frets can undergo this process is dependent on the size of the fret. A bigger fret can be filed more times than a smaller fret. Finding a good luthier technician. A luthier is someone who can
paragraphs.ca: contra els trastes. Amb el temps, els trastes es desgasten i s'aplanen. Això crea un mal contacte quan la corda s'hi prem a sobre, cosa que pot generar brunzits. El repassat de trastes és quan es lima i es torna a donar forma al traste per crear un contacte perfecte amb la corda. Quantes vegades poden passar els trastes per aquest procés depèn de la mida del traste. Un traste més gran es pot limar més vegades que un de més petit. Trobar un bon lutier o tècnic. Un lutier és algú que pot

paragraphs.en: build a guitar. A guitar technician, often shortened to tech or guitar tech, adjusts guitars but does not build them. There is often some overlap between what they can do.
paragraphs.ca: construir una guitarra. Un tècnic de guitarres, sovint abreujat com a tècnic, ajusta guitarres però no les construeix. Sovint hi ha una certa superposició entre el que poden fer.

paragraphs.en: Finding a reliable and knowledgeable luthier guitar tech can be a tricky thing to do, and like many things, often takes a bit of trial and error.
paragraphs.ca: Trobar un lutier o tècnic de guitarres fiable i amb coneixements pot ser complicat i, com moltes coses, sovint requereix una mica d'assaig i error.

paragraphs.en: The best way is via the personal recommendation of someone you know. If you take lessons, your teacher will probably know a reliable luthier that you can use.
paragraphs.ca: La millor manera és la recomanació personal d'algú que coneguis. Si prens classes, el teu professor probablement coneixerà un lutier fiable que puguis fer servir.

paragraphs.en: I had to work my way through three guitar techs before finally finding someone who was competent at their job.
paragraphs.ca: Vaig haver de passar per tres tècnics de guitarres abans de trobar finalment algú competent en la seva feina.

paragraphs.en: Home Studio If you're creating your own songs, chances are you will be using some version of a home studio, whether it's simple or complex.
paragraphs.ca: Estudi a casa. Si crees les teves pròpies cançons, és probable que facis servir alguna versió d'un estudi a casa, ja sigui senzill o complex.

paragraphs.en: We'll look at the basics of a home studio and a few upgrades you can consider getting, and then we'll talk about all the components.
paragraphs.ca: Veurem els conceptes bàsics d'un estudi a casa i unes quantes millores que pots considerar, i després parlarem de tots els components.

paragraphs.en: There are roughly four levels of home studio. 1. Your basic setup will be a computer, headphones and interface, and a DAW.
paragraphs.ca: Hi ha aproximadament quatre nivells d'estudi a casa. 1. La teva configuració bàsica serà un ordinador, uns auriculars i una interfície, i una DAW.

paragraphs.en: 2. Computer, interface, DAW and studio monitors. 3. Computer, interface, DAW, studio monitors, amplifier with power soak and impulse response modeling, software or hardware.
paragraphs.ca: 2. Ordinador, interfície, DAW i monitors d'estudi. 3. Ordinador, interfície, DAW, monitors d'estudi, amplificador amb power soak i modelatge de resposta d'impuls, programari o maquinari.

paragraphs.en: 4. Computer, interface, DAW, studio monitors, amplifier, live room or isolation box with microphones for the amplifier speaker cabinet. 5. Purpose-built studio. Level 1 is someone with their laptop. Level 5 is a purpose-built studio. Home studio components. Computer. This is the of your studio. You'll need a computer with 1. USB ports for a sound interface and external storage.
paragraphs.ca: 4. Ordinador, interfície, DAW, monitors d'estudi, amplificador, sala en directe o caixa d'aïllament amb micròfons per al cabinet d'altaveu de l'amplificador. 5. Estudi construït a propòsit. El nivell 1 és algú amb el seu portàtil. El nivell 5 és un estudi construït a propòsit. Components de l'estudi a casa. Ordinador. Aquest és el del teu estudi. Necessitaràs un ordinador amb 1. Ports USB per a una interfície de so i emmagatzematge extern.

paragraphs.en: 2. At least 8GB of RAM, ideally 16GB or even 32GB. 3. Intel i53GHz quad-core processor, Apple M1 processor or better. 4. Enough storage for your compositions. A recorded song in a DAW can run to 300 megabytes to 700 megabytes depending on how many tracks you are using.
paragraphs.ca: 2. Com a mínim 8 GB de RAM, idealment 16 GB o fins i tot 32 GB. 3. Un processador Intel i5 de 3 GHz i quatre nuclis, un processador Apple M1 o millor. 4. prou emmagatzematge per a les teves composicions. Una cançó enregistrada en una DAW pot ocupar entre 300 i 700 megabytes segons quantes pistes facis servir.

paragraphs.en: A fully produced song can be up to 5 gigabytes. 250 gigabytes internal drive with an external drive is a good starting point. If the internal and external drives are solid state, even better.
paragraphs.ca: Una cançó totalment produïda pot arribar als 5 gigabytes. Un disc intern de 250 gigabytes amb un disc extern és un bon punt de partida. Si els discs interns i externs són d'estat sòlid, encara millor.

paragraphs.en: I use a late 2015, it's 2022 when I'm writing this book, so this computer is currently 7 years old, iMac with a 3.2 GHz quad-core Intel i5 with 8 GB of RAM. My computer is fast enough for doing recording, one track at a time, working with a virtual orchestra and recording rock music with sample libraries. It slows down a little and playback starts and stops with bigger projects, so I'll upgrade the RAM to 16 GB or 32 GB sometime soon, but for 90% of what I do with it,
paragraphs.ca: Jo faig servir un iMac de finals del 2015 —és el 2022 quan escric aquest llibre, així que aquest ordinador té actualment 7 anys— amb un Intel i5 de 3,2 GHz i quatre nuclis i 8 GB de RAM. El meu ordinador és prou ràpid per enregistrar, una pista alhora, treballar amb una orquestra virtual i enregistrar música de rock amb biblioteques de mostres. S'alenteix una mica i la reproducció arrenca i s'atura amb projectes més grans, així que aviat li ampliaré la RAM a 16 GB o 32 GB, però per al 90% del que hi faig,

paragraphs.en: it's fine. The point is, you need a computer that is good enough, but it doesn't have to be a supercomputer. But do make sure you check the specifications for any software, plugins, libraries, equipment you intend to use. Sound interface. This is a box that you can plug into your computer and then plug instruments, microphones, headphones, studio monitors, and other musical equipment into. At a basic level, you can get a USB dongle with an input
paragraphs.ca: va bé. La qüestió és que necessites un ordinador que sigui prou bo, però no cal que sigui un superordinador. Però assegura't de comprovar les especificacions de qualsevol programari, connector, biblioteca o equip que tinguis previst fer servir. Interfície de so. Aquesta és una caixa que pots connectar al teu ordinador i on després pots connectar instruments, micròfons, auriculars, monitors d'estudi i altres equips musicals. A un nivell bàsic, pots aconseguir un adaptador USB amb una entrada

paragraphs.en: for your guitar and an output for your headphones. These can go for around £20. Beringer makes something like this that I started with. The next level up is something that can handle studio monitors, headphones, two guitars or microphones, with gain controls and line instrument inputs. The Focusrite Scarlett. 2i4 is an excellent option at this level.
paragraphs.ca: per a la teva guitarra i una sortida per als teus auriculars. Aquests poden costar unes 20 lliures. Beringer en fa un de semblant, amb què vaig començar. El nivell següent és una cosa que pugui gestionar monitors d'estudi, auriculars, dues guitarres o micròfons, amb controls de guany i entrades de línia i d'instrument. La Focusrite Scarlett 2i4 és una opció excel·lent en aquest nivell.

paragraphs.en: I've used mine for years now and many students love them. These are great for recording vocals, guitar or other instruments where you need a maximum of two microphones. These cost around £130 to £200. They can handle line, instrument or XLR inputs with a variety of outputs.
paragraphs.ca: Fa anys que faig servir la meva i a molts estudiants els encanten. Són fantàstiques per enregistrar veus, guitarra o altres instruments quan necessites un màxim de dos micròfons. Costen entre unes 130 i 200 lliures. Poden gestionar entrades de línia, d'instrument o XLR amb una varietat de sortides.

paragraphs.en: The difference in price for similar interfaces is usually down to features and the quality of the audio-to-digital conversion, known as DAC for Digital Analog Converter.
paragraphs.ca: La diferència de preu entre interfícies similars normalment es deu a les prestacions i a la qualitat de la conversió d'àudio a digital, coneguda com a DAC, per Digital Analog Converter.

paragraphs.en: Higher quality DACs are usually more expensive. You only start to need more complex interfaces if you want to record multiple instruments or microphones at once.
paragraphs.ca: Els DAC de més qualitat solen ser més cars. Només comences a necessitar interfícies més complexes si vols enregistrar diversos instruments o micròfons alhora.

paragraphs.en: For example, if you're recording drums, you can need a minimum of 10 microphones. Usually, at this level, Rack is a little bit more than a Interfaces with plenty of inputs are used. You will also need a powerful computer to track that many microphones at once.
paragraphs.ca: Per exemple, si enregistres bateria, pots necessitar un mínim de 10 micròfons. Normalment, en aquest nivell, Rack és una mica més que una... S'utilitzen interfícies amb moltes entrades. També necessitaràs un ordinador potent per enregistrar tantes pistes de micròfon alhora.

paragraphs.en: Headphones. You need some way to listen to what you have recorded. Good speakers are expensive, so if you are on a limited budget, I would recommend a semi-decent pair of studio headphones. Your headphones should be wired.
paragraphs.ca: Auriculars. Necessites alguna manera d'escoltar què has enregistrat. Els bons altaveus són cars, així que si tens un pressupost limitat, et recomanaria uns auriculars d'estudi semidecents. Els teus auriculars haurien de ser amb cable.

paragraphs.en: Wireless, or Bluetooth, headphones can have a small amount of latency. When you are just listening to music for fun, this isn't a problem, but when you are recording, this latency will be noticeable and incredibly annoying.
paragraphs.ca: Els auriculars sense fil, o Bluetooth, poden tenir una petita quantitat de latència. Quan només escoltes música per plaer, això no és cap problema, però quan enregistres, aquesta latència serà notable i increïblement molesta.

paragraphs.en: When using the headphones, plug them directly into your sound interface. Have them set loud enough, but don't go blasting your ears with them.
paragraphs.ca: Quan facis servir els auriculars, connecta'ls directament a la teva interfície de so. Tingues-los a un volum prou alt, però no et rebentis les orelles amb ells.

paragraphs.en: Also be aware that with prolonged use, your ears get used to loudness, So for a given loudness, it can be perceived as getting quieter as time goes on, leading to increasing the volume over and over, which is a recipe for long-term hearing damage.
paragraphs.ca: Tingues també en compte que, amb un ús prolongat, les orelles s'acostumen al volum, de manera que, per a un volum determinat, es pot percebre com si sonés més fluix a mesura que passa el temps, cosa que porta a apujar el volum una vegada i una altra, que és la recepta per a una pèrdua auditiva a llarg termini.

paragraphs.en: When using headphones, take them off every 20 minutes or so to give your ears a little rest and reset your perception of volume.
paragraphs.ca: Quan facis servir auriculars, treu-te'ls cada 20 minuts més o menys per donar una mica de descans a les orelles i reiniciar la teva percepció del volum.

paragraphs.en: Monitors Monitors is a fancy name for good quality speakers. Normal PC speakers aren't good enough. They have a limited frequency response.
paragraphs.ca: Monitors. Monitors és un nom elegant per a altaveus de bona qualitat. Els altaveus normals d'ordinador no són prou bons. Tenen una resposta de freqüències limitada.

paragraphs.en: Ideally, you want something that is powered, with separate bass and treble cones. You'll need speaker cables to connect the monitors to your sound interface.
paragraphs.ca: Idealment, vols una cosa que sigui amplificada, amb cons separats de greus i d'aguts. Necessitaràs cables d'altaveu per connectar els monitors a la teva interfície de so.

paragraphs.en: Usually, these are not included with the monitors. I found the M-Audio BX8 to be pretty good for this. Set up your monitors so they form two points of an equilateral triangle, with you forming the third point.
paragraphs.ca: Normalment, aquests no s'inclouen amb els monitors. Vaig trobar que els M-Audio BX8 estan força bé per a això. Col·loca els monitors de manera que formin dos punts d'un triangle equilàter, amb tu formant el tercer punt.

paragraphs.en: They should be pointing directly at you. Good monitors can cost £300 for a pair.
paragraphs.ca: Haurien d'apuntar directament cap a tu. Els bons monitors poden costar 300 lliures la parella.

paragraphs.en: Power Soak, Loadbox. This is a device you can plug your power amp into that will make the signal smaller.
paragraphs.ca: Power Soak, Loadbox. Aquest és un dispositiu on pots connectar la teva etapa de potència i que farà que el senyal sigui més petit.

paragraphs.en: Valve amplifiers sound best when they are turned up loud, but if you are recording at home, this may not be practical and you may well get complaints from your neighbour's housemates, not to mention damaging your hearing unless you can put your amp in an isolated room.
paragraphs.ca: Els amplificadors de vàlvules sonen millor quan els puges ben fort, però si enregistres a casa potser no és pràctic i és ben probable que rebis queixes dels veïns i dels companys de pis, per no parlar de fer malbé la teva oïda, tret que puguis posar l'amplificador en una sala aïllada.

paragraphs.en: Additionally, you cannot plug the output of your amplifier into your sound interface, as the signal will be too strong and will damage the sound interface.
paragraphs.ca: A més, no pots connectar la sortida del teu amplificador a la teva interfície de so, ja que el senyal serà massa fort i farà malbé la interfície de so.

paragraphs.en: A power soak is a device that is placed between the amplifier and speaker cabinet, which makes the signal quieter without, in theory, losing any of the tone.
paragraphs.ca: Un power soak és un dispositiu que es col·loca entre l'amplificador i el cabinet de l'altaveu, que fa que el senyal sigui més silenciós sense, en teoria, perdre res del so.

paragraphs.en: Popular models include THD hotplate, Marshall power brake, and two-notes torpedo range. Many load boxes come with a line-out which allows you to plug the output of the load box into your sound interface.
paragraphs.ca: Els models populars inclouen el THD hotplate, el Marshall power brake i la gamma torpedo de two-notes. Moltes load boxes inclouen una sortida de línia que et permet connectar la sortida de la load box a la teva interfície de so.

paragraphs.en: There are good YouTube videos demonstrating the difference between different load boxes.
paragraphs.ca: Hi ha bons vídeos de YouTube que mostren la diferència entre diferents load boxes.

paragraphs.en: Impulse response. Everything in your signal chain affects your tone, including, as we mentioned earlier, your speaker cabinet.
paragraphs.ca: Resposta d'impuls. Tot a la teva cadena de senyal afecta el teu so, incloent-hi, com hem esmentat abans, el cabinet del teu altaveu.

paragraphs.en: Impulse response software hardware will model the effect of a speaker cabinet on your tone. This usually comes as software, but there are also hardware variants.
paragraphs.ca: El programari o el maquinari de resposta d'impuls modelarà l'efecte d'un cabinet d'altaveu sobre el teu so. Normalment ve com a programari, però també hi ha variants de maquinari.

paragraphs.en: A company called Two Notes has software and hardware solutions that you can look into. Many modern DAWs come with plugins that will load impulse responses, and Two Notes offer a free plugin you can use with your DAW.
paragraphs.ca: Una empresa anomenada Two Notes té solucions de programari i de maquinari que pots mirar. Moltes DAW modernes inclouen connectors que carreguen respostes d'impuls, i Two Notes ofereix un connector gratuït que pots fer servir amb la teva DAW.

paragraphs.en: Isolation Box This is a large wooden and padded box that you can place your speaker cabinet in, along with a microphone.
paragraphs.ca: Caixa d'aïllament. Aquesta és una caixa gran de fusta i encoixinada on pots posar el cabinet del teu altaveu, juntament amb un micròfon.

paragraphs.en: It is acoustically insulated so that sound can't escape, meaning you can turn up your amp nice and loud without it disturbing anyone or blasting your eardrums.
paragraphs.ca: Està aïllada acústicament perquè el so no pugui escapar, cosa que vol dir que pots pujar l'amplificador ben fort sense molestar ningú ni rebentar-te els timpans.

paragraphs.en: These are a good solution to recording at home, and if you don't want to buy one, you can build one. These can sound a little dead compared to a nice studio room, but they are a great solution to recording your nice amp at home.
paragraphs.ca: Són una bona solució per enregistrar a casa i, si no en vols comprar una, te'n pots construir una. Poden sonar una mica mortes comparades amb una bona sala d'estudi, però són una solució fantàstica per enregistrar el teu bon amplificador a casa.

paragraphs.en: Microphones If you are recording your guitar, mic'd up, you will need a microphone. When it comes to recording guitar cabinets, the industry standard is the Shure SM57.
paragraphs.ca: Micròfons. Si enregistres la teva guitarra microfonejada, necessitaràs un micròfon. A l'hora d'enregistrar cabinets de guitarra, l'estàndard del sector és el Shure SM57.

paragraphs.en: Set the microphone up using a mic stand, pointing directly at one of your speaker cones, as close as you can get to the speaker cone.
paragraphs.ca: Col·loca el micròfon amb un suport de micròfon, apuntant directament a un dels cons del teu altaveu, tan a prop del con de l'altaveu com puguis.

paragraphs.en: The exact position of the microphone will affect the tone that you capture. My album, Impetuous Desire, was recorded using a single SM57.
paragraphs.ca: La posició exacta del micròfon afectarà el so que captis. El meu disc, Impetuous Desire, es va enregistrar amb un sol SM57.

paragraphs.en: Some people like to use an additional microphone elsewhere in the room to capture the ambience. When using multiple microphones, you have to be careful that they are in phase.
paragraphs.ca: A algunes persones els agrada fer servir un micròfon addicional en un altre punt de la sala per captar l'ambient. Quan fas servir diversos micròfons, has d'anar amb compte que estiguin en fase.

paragraphs.en: Going into the complexities of phase is outside the scope of this book, but a quick Google will tell you all about it. Live room If you want to go all out, you can go and build a live room.
paragraphs.ca: Endinsar-se en les complexitats de la fase queda fora de l'abast d'aquest llibre, però una cerca ràpida a Google t'ho explicarà tot. Sala en directe. Si vols anar a totes, pots anar a construir una sala en directe.

paragraphs.en: This is a sectioned-off room that has thick walls for sound isolation. It may or may not have a window. This will let you record amplifiers and other instruments easily and to a very high quality.
paragraphs.ca: És una sala separada amb parets gruixudes per a l'aïllament acústic. Pot tenir finestra o no. Això et permetrà enregistrar amplificadors i altres instruments fàcilment i amb una qualitat molt alta.

paragraphs.en: Some people build these in their basement or build a studio in their garden that has a live and control room. When you go this far, you can create studio-quality recordings at home, while the best option, this is also the most expensive and most fun.
paragraphs.ca: Algunes persones les construeixen al soterrani o construeixen un estudi al jardí amb una sala en directe i una sala de control. Quan arribes tan lluny, pots crear enregistraments amb qualitat d'estudi a casa; tot i que és la millor opció, també és la més cara i la més divertida.

paragraphs.en: Section 5. Your Environment
paragraphs.ca: Secció 5. El teu entorn

segments.text: Section 5. Your Environment
An often neglected area of practice is controlling your environment.
People have argued for millennia over whether or not human beings have free will,
or if we are merely products of our environment.
The truth is we have free will,
and our environment makes using that in certain ways easier or harder.
So by using our free will to influence our environment,
we can make our practice much more effective.
Let's dive into exactly how to do that.
Minimize distractions and enhance your focus.
There are a handful of variables that will affect the rate at which your guitar playing will improve.
1. Time spent practicing.
2. What you are practicing.
3. How you are practicing.
4. How focused you are when you practice.
By making sure we are highly focused, we will learn faster.
If you spend less time practicing but are highly focused,
you will learn faster than if you spend more time practicing with low focus,
with the ideal situation being more time practicing in a highly focused state.
So make sure you minimize distractions.
The first thing to do is make sure that you are not doing anything else when you are practicing.
Do not practice while watching TV, listening to music, watching YouTube, etc.
Keeping your practice space tidy and neatly organized
will also help you focus on the task at hand.
Guitar practice time is for guitar practice, that's it.
Third-party distractions
You also want to minimize external distractions,
distractions that are caused by others.
Close those extra windows on your computer,
put your phone on airplane mode,
and turn off your email alerts.
If there are other people around you,
ask them not to disturb you for the next XYZ minutes.
When it comes to your significant other and children,
you may have to make some adjustments,
but try and find a system that works for everyone.
If you are constantly having your practice interrupted over things that can wait,
you are going to struggle to focus and make progress.
A great benefit of a dedicated home studio is that you can shut the door
and leave the outside world behind to focus on your music.
Have your environment set up to practice.
This is easier to implement for some than it is for others,
but the more dedicated your environment is to practice the better.
The best possible environment is a home studio practice room whose only purpose is practicing the guitar
But I realize that is not possible for everyone
The next best thing is whatever your environment is, make it conducive to practice
You need to minimize the mental resistance to starting practice
Often overcoming this resistance to getting started is harder than the practice itself
This means that your guitar should always be out and ready to use
If you keep your guitar in a case, you have to get it out of its case before you practice.
As silly as this sounds, it creates a bit of resistance that must be overcome before practice can start.
Here are a few things you can do to help decrease the resistance to getting started with practice.
1. Guitar on a stand and ready to be used.
2. Guitar is plugged into an amplifier.
All electrics are plugged into the wall and ready to be used.
3. Practice material in order and on a music stand near the guitar
4. The metronome and tuner are both on the desk and ready to be used
5. Picks within arm's reach and ready to be used
6. Footrest under desk or nearby
7. Paper and pencil if needed, ready and neatly organized
As you can see, the main theme is that everything you could need to practice is out and ready
so that you just have to step into your practice space and you're ready to go.
I would also advise keeping your desk, if you're using one as part of your practice space,
tidy and ready to be used.
If you don't have a desk, I would strongly advise getting one.
You can improvise a desk with a large flat piece of wood
and two small chests of drawers from Ikea or find one second hand.
Either way, having a good-sized desk is great for productivity.
How to practice with a computer
There are some fantastic ways that we can use a computer and different programs to help us practice the guitar more effectively.
Often people use their computers incredibly ineffectively.
Let's get started with computers and tablets.
They are not the same thing.
A computer involves a screen, keyboard and mouse, and a base station.
A laptop will roll these into one, will count laptops and desktops as equivalent things.
A tablet is a single screen.
Tablets are great at some things and not so great at others.
When it comes to guitar practice, I am yet to find an effective way to use a tablet.
I have, however, found plenty of great ways to use a computer.
If you're going to set yourself up for practicing and recording, then I would strongly advise using a computer and not a tablet.
If money is tight, a second-hand iMac or Mac Mini is a good option.
Tablets are mainly for entertainment and browsing-style activities. Computers are for deep work.
There are one or two notable exceptions with using tablets for deep work, mainly for writing and composing music using notation.
However, when it comes to practice, a computer is best.
There are two main areas to using a computer effectively.
One, using the correct programs.
Two, using those programs effectively.
Using the correct programs.
The types of programs that you use will fall into two main categories.
One, writing guitar tablature, usually called TAB for short.
Two, recording audio.
Some programs will do both.
Why write guitar tab?
If you are learning to play the guitar, you're going to be working through a lot of guitar tabs.
You will be getting exercises, maybe from a teacher, and writing out your ideas.
The benefit of using a computer program to write guitar tabs is that you can
1. Play the tab back so you can hear how it should sound.
2. Add custom metronome drum tracks to help you understand the rhythm.
We go over how to do this in the appendix on programming metronomes.
3. Store things efficiently so that you don't have hundreds of pieces of paper lying around.
4. Create backing tracks for pieces that you are practicing.
5. Slow down the song or exercise that you are learning.
6. Compose ideas and share them with your friends to collaborate.
7. Export your tab scores to PDF, slash audio, slash print, slash MyDi, slash MusicXML, etc.
Why record audio?
As a beginner, you will probably not need to record audio.
In fact, given the learning curve that recording programs can have,
I would recommend that you don't worry about this until you're reaching the late beginner, intermediate level.
For most people, this is after several months of lessons.
But when you do reach that level, it is a great tool.
Recording your playing will allow you to listen back to your playing and analyze your mistakes.
One thing that is quite useful is being able to visually see your recording against a grid,
which visually tells you if your playing is in time or not,
and if it isn't in time, you will be able to see if you're early, late, or just all over the place.
Figure 11. Waveforms.
Recording programs become useful when you want to compose music.
This could be anything from backing tracks to improvise over
to composing your own songs and instrumental pieces of music.
The top-level recording programs are known as digital audio workstations,
often abbreviated to DAWs.
DAWs will allow you to
1. Record and manipulate audio.
2. Input musical notes and play them back via MIDI data.
3. Use different sound libraries to play back your compositions. See below for an explanation.
4. Control sound libraries from an external keyboard. For example, use your keyboard to play the cello.
5. Loop sections. Very useful for practice.
6. Mix, EQ, and add effects to your tracks.
7. Use VST or AU. See below for explanation.
8. And more. For example, you could record a guitar riff into a DAW, then loop it so that it plays several times in a row.
Every piece of professionally released music that you have listened to in the last 20 years has used a DAW.
DAW are used for composing, recording, mixing and mastering music.
MIDI, spelt M-I-D-I.
Data. MIDI stands for Musical Instrument Digital Interface.
This is a computer protocol for connecting musical instruments, usually keyboards, to computers and each other.
A MIDI device can connect to a computer via a sound interface or other MIDI-capable devices.
MIDI is also a way to write...

I can write musical notes to a computer file to share between different programs. Nearly all music programs can create MIDI files. For example, I can write a tab in Guitar Pro, export that to MIDI and open it in Logic Pro.
Sound libraries.
These are collections of pre-recorded sounds.
Let's say you were writing a drum part for a guitar riff that you wrote.
You could purchase a sound library where someone has recorded different parts of a drum kit,
and these sounds are played back with your programmed drum part.
Sound libraries usually include different articulations,
which are different ways of playing a note.
A simple example is that a cello could be played arco, bowed, or pizzicato, plucked.
More articulations with better programming, how the library moves between notes,
gives better quality and more realistic playback, but also tend to make libraries more expensive.
Sound libraries exist for every instrument imaginable, including orchestral instruments and the human voice.
They are a great way to make realistic demos and are used in commercial releases.
For those that want a challenge, you can even record your own sound library.
There is an appendix at the end with some recommendations on different sound libraries you can try.
VST and AU
VST stands for Virtual Studio Technology and AU stands for Audio Unit.
VST are used for Windows systems and AU are used for Apple systems.
Logic Pro and GarageBand. They accomplish the same thing. They allow you to add extra software to
your DAW so that it can do more stuff. This could be anything from a reverb plugin to a software
guitar amplifier to a sound library that allows you to play back any orchestral instrument
realistically. Software companies typically release their products in both VST and AU versions.
Program recommendations
For writing tab, I recommend GuitarPro.
Creates professional-looking guitar tabs and plays them back.
GuitarPro is designed around a tab-first input.
You can add chord and scale diagrams to your tabs and compose for multiple instruments.
It's designed for guitar players.
It's great for writing songs, exercises, and collaborating with other musicians.
GuitarPro retails at around $80.
